disclaimer: SIMULATED REVIEW. These 500 scenarios are scripted heuristic inspections executed against the real rendered application. No human participated. A passing scenario means the automated checks found no defect, NOT that a person understood the page.
pendingHumanVerification: Can a novice explain what PET, PE and PP are after a 30-90 second walkthrough?
Can a novice explain what a peptide is in their own words?
Can a novice explain what the Selectivity Priority dial does?
Can a novice state what the displayed results do NOT prove?
These require moderated testing with real participants and consent. NOT measured here.

checkCatalogue.title: Screen has exactly one plain-English h1
Screen states its purpose in one sentence
Every displayed statistic carries a label and a unit or direction
Specialist terms appear with an inline explanation
Scientific limitations are stated where results are shown
The screen handles its empty, loading and error states explicitly
No element forces the page to scroll sideways
Animation can be switched off and nothing is lost
All content sits inside a navigable landmark
Every chart, canvas and diagram has an accessible name
Numbers say whether they were computed, sampled, estimated or illustrated
A route onward from this screen is present
Destructive or confusing actions can be undone or reset
